title: mnemonica .tactica definitions
description: Per-type declaration metadata of one .tactica source (format version 1.0/1.1). Keys are fullPaths and must match hierarchy.json node fullPaths exactly; see tactica/README.md for the join rules.

version.description: Format version. Absent means 1.0 (pre-versioning and 1.0 outputs are identical in shape).

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of generation. Informational only; readers must not require it.

definitions.description: Map from fullPath to declaration info. May be empty when the source declares no types.

name.description: The declared type name. Never collection-prefixed; equal to the last dotted segment of the entry key.

location.description: `file:line:col`, 1-based line and column, relative to the project root (forward slashes). Files outside the project root may stay absolute.

kind.description: How the type was declared. Generators write "define" (define()/lazy()) or "decorate" (@decorate()/Type.decorate()).

parent.description: The parent type's fullPath, null at a root. Must match another key in this file (and a hierarchy.json node) when non-null.

strictChain.description: Whether the type chain enforces strict chaining semantics.

blockErrors.description: Whether errors thrown during construction are blocked (swallowed into the chain).
